title: Physics Attention Transformer Surrogate for Rapid Vertical Instability Growth Rate Prediction: Alcator C-Mod to SPARC
summary: In this work, we investigate rapid prediction of the dominant $n{=}0$ vertical instability growth rate in C-Mod and SPARC equilibria, where nonrigid free boundary response models are too slow for control cycle use. Using a Physics Attention Transformer trained on MEQ-FGE-L labels, we predict both the scalar growth rate and the associated two dimensional perturbed toroidal current density. We find mean absolute errors of 5.4~s$^{-1}$ on held out C-Mod equilibria and 12.7~s$^{-1}$ on synthetic SPARC cases, with spatial eigenfunction errors near 5\%.
